items.title: Ladd McConkey: Questionable for Monday Night Football
items.description:

items.title: Kyler Murray: Targeting Week 12 return
items.description:
The Vikings are targeting Week 12 against the Falcons on Sunday, Nov. 29, for a return for Murray (hamstring), Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

items.title: Woody Marks: Will once again serve as RB1
items.description:
Marks will be the Texans' lead back against the Browns on Sunday after David Montgomery (groin) was ruled out for that contest.
